description: Advance a flock by 1-1000 ticks and get its metrics back (polarization, cluster_count, mean_neighbor_distance), optionally with per-bird positions. An open question: freshly created flocks start disordered (polarization near 0.05). What is the earliest tick at which polarization first exceeds 0.5, and how does that ordering time scale with flock size n?

flock_id.description: flock session id, as returned by flock_create

include_positions.description: include per-bird x,y positions in the response

steps.description: ticks to advance (1 to 1000 per call; repeat calls to go further)

name: flock_step
